notes.title: July Development Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Steel Dragons!

It has been a few weeks since the Steam Next Fest, and we hope you’ve had fun playing the Project Haven demo. While still relatively early in development (we’re officially still in alpha and almost everything is still subject to change), we feel it represents our vision for the game going forward, and we’ve been overjoyed with the positive response to it so far. We’ve been relatively quiet since the festival, as we’ve returned to our natural, subterranean home in the Code Mines, slowly excavating the bits and bytes required to construct the final game.

You talkin’ to me?
From the feedback we received on the demo, we’ve identified and squashed a lot of the biggest issues with the game already. Check out our Twitter feed to see some of our smaller updates. Still, one element clearly stood out as especially divisive among players - our combat bark system. While it’s functioning as intended, players are split on whether it brings flavour to the battles or just adds unnecessary noise to the battlefield, and player response varies a lot between characters.

[previewyoutube=ZkhPFlDQWY0;full][/previewyoutube]
While we’re tweaking some lines of dialogue to better represent battlefield conditions and our thematic intent, we’ll be taking a hard look at ways for players to control the frequency and intensity of combat chatter. 

Move like you mean it
Beyond that, we’ve been focusing on character pathing to make sure that characters no longer wiggle into locations that they can’t path their way out of. On the subject of movement, we’ve implemented a whole new advanced technique - a combined ‘slice the pie’ command that allows characters to strafe their way around an obstacle while maintaining aim on a fixed point. A great technique for passing a potentially deadly doorway, as you can see in this clip:

[previewyoutube=Pju48WsVKIs;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve also improved how characters move when leaning around cover. Characters can now take a half-step out of cover to get a better look around a corner at the cost of a single action point, or just lean slightly to minimise the amount of meat you’re exposing to incoming lead.

[previewyoutube=PJUgR_eKGRU;full][/previewyoutube]
And because you should never skip leg day, we’ve added more Crouch and Prone options to the UI. You can now perform these actions through the radial menu or via the action bar. Of course, true operators have their hotkeys memorized to keep that workout going all battle long.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/741832287d259bf405aa60a064de193913333143.gif

On the subject of UI improvement, your character’s planned movement path is now fully visible during Free Mode. You’ll see a continuous line drawn along your planned movement path, instead of just the dashed version during Turn-based mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/7e929fca0103073efeaafb6201704363fd95849e.gif

And one frequently requested quality-of-life improvement: You can now hold the Middle Mouse button to open up a whole new world of camera movement options, for when you absolutely need the perfect angle on a firefight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/05d7aa1865621bcfcb7b11edd741d21f236afb29.gif

The Future Of Combat, Tomorrow
And we’ve got plenty more changes in the pipeline. The UI is getting some more love across the board to both make it quicker and easier to use, but also present more pertinent info to players at all times. We’ll also be implementing a way to control camera visibility especially within buildings to better navigate in those situations.

We’re massaging the brains of our AI grunts so that they’ll have a more natural range of behaviours. Right now they’re either very deadly who’ll set up the perfect shot, or blind to the easiest opportunity. Plus, some bugs have been identified causing NPCs to play less-than-optimally.

And we’re really going deep into the brains of our characters to tweak their combat barks. We’ll be adding new lines to cover more possible scenarios and reduce repetition of dialogue, and increase the amount of interaction and combat banter between characters. Plus, some clumsier lines are either getting axed or rewritten to better convey the tone we want to project.

These are only some of the improvements we’ll be making, but stay tuned for more updates!

(Dream)hack the planet
Some of you might have noticed that we’ve taken our Steam demo down. Don’t feel bad, though - it served its purpose well, and it has been safely recycled. A new and updated demo featuring some of the improvements mentioned above will be rolling out on July 24th, coinciding with our appearance at Dreamhack Beyond! Fans can claim free digital ticket events here, or just return here on Steam to try out the latest version.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/e4822c4bc85714b23efb80d360f6a8c9714f5df7.gif

We’ll also have an even further improved version of the demo ready for you all to enjoy later in August, where we’ll be making a (digital) appearance at Gamescom. Stay tuned, wishlist and follow Project Haven on Steam for updates as and when they happen in your news feed. Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and join our community Discord either. It’s where all the cool kids hang out.

We’re doing numbers
And to wrap up, some interesting statistics from our time at the Next Fest:

 Almost 700 of you left us comments. We love to hear from you!
 Most players (72%) played the demo in Normal mode. 20% played on Easy, and only 8% challenged Hard or Insane modes.
 74% of you turned off the profanity filter. You clearly like your mercs rude and crude.
 A mere 5% played the demo in co-op mode. Next time round, give it a spin! The game is designed for co-op from the ground up, so share the fun with a friend.

Thanks for your time, and we’ll see you all at Dreamhack!

notes.title: June Development Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Steel Dragons!

It’s been a while since we’ve given you a peek at development on Project Haven on Steam but if you’ve been following us on social media or our Discord then you may have already seen some of these exciting details. We’ve been hard at work making sure that this gritty dystopian story is as fun, immersive and nerve-wracking as it can be. Project Haven is our attempt to fill a niche that has gone unfilled for decades now - a story-rich, immersive squad tactics game with co-op, PvP and all the simulation-style details you’d expect of the classics.

If you’re dying to dive into the world for a closer look, there will be a playable demo available from June 16th to June 22nd during the Steam Game Festival Summer Edition. We are also honored to have discovered that our game Project Haven has been featured in the Strategy game section by Steam! Watch the Feature on Youtube:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=egSAD6IbqtU

Everything you’ll see in this Alpha Demo is a work-in-progress but will contain the first three campaign missions as well as a taste of Project Haven’s 4 player online co-op.


In the meantime, here are just some of the updates we’ve been working on:

Updated Aiming System
We’ve updated our aiming system so now you can spend extra action points to increase your merc’s accuracy incrementally up to a maximum determined by your character’s skills, weapon and mods. This allows you a more fine grained control over your aiming and action points, while also opening up opportunities for further customization of your characters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/e23d0b8d5c47e6b9a72b8d72a41c1bafff9f339b.gif

Updated AI Behaviors
We’ve also updated the AI, one of the most significant changes is if an idle enemy spots one of your characters from far away now they can go investigate, opening up a whole world of sneaky ambush tactics!
[previewyoutube=FPFv0wJeMlo;full][/previewyoutube]

Destructible Cover
Not all cover is the same. Some types will deflect bullets, some can be pierced and some just blow up when shot, so be careful when choosing which one you get behind.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/0dc9b2815a9e5baa6b9a7c765e89e22c336bd658.gif
[/th]
        [th]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/934f2827954ee30eccb060e3a6ac11bdd13808f6.gif
[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Improved UI
To improve readability of available options for the player we’ve added some new features to the interface, including adding an icon on nearby vault/mantle points, highlighting usable objects and visibility indicators between the enemies and the player mercenaries.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/b2eb5260ece2ee1257339eea500a80a4a51c96e2.gif[/th]
        [th]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/98468e0b89134c93290a16ad669835b31edc520b.gif[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Cameras
We recently revealed a new challenge that you and your Steel Dragons will be facing. In Project Haven cameras can pose as a roadblock for your path, but can also be an opportunity with the right skills.
[previewyoutube=lgnNLPwTQX0;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lgnNLPwTQX0[/previewyoutube]


With all these new and updated features Haven City is just waiting to be explored. The Project Haven campaign will feature handcrafted maps each telling a story about its residents and its history. Illuminated by flashes of firefights, you can expect to feel as though you’ve just stepped right into a warzone. Explore clogged streets, broken down slumburbs, dark alleyways and more. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/a1e6895ab1e026016f3493f09f56a5fc9a5821ce.png


We’re incredibly pleased with what we’ve accomplished with Project Haven so far and seeing the gaming community enjoy our game as much as we do is incredibly exciting.
We’re also incredibly pleased to share you with the recent accolades Project Haven has received:

The Big Indie Pitch, PC Edition - First Place (2020)

By participating in this event we hoped we would receive some valuable feedback but coming away the winner of The Big Indie Pitch left us incredibly pleased. 

Epic MegaGrants Recipient (2020)

Epic Games awarded us a MegaGrant, a fund which will help us continue the work that we’ve been doing, and we were absolutely thrilled by their support and recognition.

WN Dev Contest Best Game Winner (2021)

Project Haven is the squad tactics game to keep an eye on, according to the judges of the WN Dev Contest. We were super happy to have earned two Best Game awards out of more than 550 entrants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/e625f88c3955f9637a3dce5def5aa16ecaae6a29.png

Thank you!

We can’t thank our community enough for your continued support for Project Haven and we can’t wait to show everyone more and continue to impress!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/108711a5cd423ddc4be25dcf1902a07aab4244a1.png


Don’t forget you can also join our community on Discord or Reddit, along with following us on our social media: 

Twitter: https://twitter.com/code351 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/code351games 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/code351games/

notes.title: July Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Steel Dragons!

We have some exciting news to share with you, but first, we would like to thank our followers for your consistent support in this journey. And If you want to join our growing community, be on top of the game’s development progress and give us your invaluable feedback, please follow us on Twitter, where we post images/videos every week, or join us on Discord where you can talk to us any time, and also get to see some sneak peeks and work in progress that we usually don’t share on any other platform. 

AI
Now back to the news. In case you missed it, in the last development update we shared some of the improvements we have been doing to the UI and gameplay. Since then, we also have been working heavily on AI. We have a lot of tweakable parameters to make the AI challenging and human-like, so we ended up using machine learning to do its parameterization. Here's a sneak peek!
[previewyoutube=hq26OPBCxRA;full][/previewyoutube]
We still have a lot of work ahead of us. But this already gave us a solid base to do some testing and work on top of. 

Your Feedback
And as a lot of you already know, Project Haven was at Steam Game Festival where we finally were able to share our demo with you! And you have been awesome with your support and feedback. Some of the most requested features that we’ve already implemented were:

 An updated the interrupt cone visibility
[previewyoutube=bojU_ANDbNs;full][/previewyoutube]
 More tooltips and information in the UI.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/cc963200ed2d19494b6fb37d0ca576586bcd0b3a.png


Another top features that were requested that we are still working on are:


 New key binding system
 Filter for mature language


Gamescom
We are excited to announce that Project Haven was selected by Indie Arena Booth to be part of gamescom 2020. Due to the unfortunate situation our world is in, this year's event will be happening online. As such, from 27th to 30th August, we will have our own multiplayer virtual booth that can be visited by anyone for free through any browser. 

For all of you that missed the Steam Games Festival demo we have great news: you will also be able to play our alpha demo (now with a few extras and tooltips!) throughout those days. Please come visit us in our booth! We hope to see you there and we can’t wait to talk to you guys!

Check the trailer to see a sneak preview of the many titles will be there!
[previewyoutube=p55uCmjxmWI;full][/previewyoutube]

And you can also check their official website to see the full list of indie games present.

Thanks for reading, until next time!

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Steel Dragons!

As usual, we have some development updates that we’d like to share with you!

UI
One of the aspects we thought that needed some improvement was the game’s UI. And even though we plan on having an UI overhaul at a later date (that can only be possible after having all the UI requirements set in place), we have been adding some new needed elements in the game’s interface. 
As you may remember, the Steel Dragon’s HQ is where the player will be able to manage their inventory, buy and sell items on the black market, check the crew’s health, hear their thoughts and opinions about the current situation, read all gathered intel and lore, get new missions and select the mission to start (phew..that was a long sentence). As such, we have been making some long time planned improvements to the way the player can interact with some of those different sections of the HQ (more to be added soon).
[previewyoutube=Fb5xFw2dyGw;full][/previewyoutube]

So additionally to the mission selection UI showed to you previously in the latest development update, we have also implemented a new market system with an immersive view and a very useful comparison window.
[previewyoutube=uafl4OLQzo4;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=7JJusgc1plQ;full][/previewyoutube]

GAMEPLAY
We also have been adding new content to the game. We finally added one more enemy faction! Which, we used right away to test out our new motion capture setup (we wanted to see those flaps move!). 
[previewyoutube=hLRPRuIBudQ;full][/previewyoutube]

And even though this animation still needs some work to do, our new setup is already helping us fill out the streets of Haven city with some harsh realities of the Project Haven universe.
[previewyoutube=Kr09nwpsQww;full][/previewyoutube]

To give the player that extra satisfaction when hitting critical shots when fighting those gangs in Haven, we added a new reworked kill cam system.
[previewyoutube=QKIAyP6ZWb0;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally we have been implementing more game mechanics, such as the option to use ladders to access Haven City rooftops, which not only can provide tactical advantage against your enemies, but are also great sightseeing spots!
[previewyoutube=rpxfMsM58rM;full]https://youtu.be/rpxfMsM58rM[/previewyoutube]

Here is a sneak peak of one of the many barks that our characters have: 
[previewyoutube=i6ICKvJzZwk;full]https://youtu.be/i6ICKvJzZwk[/previewyoutube]

REDDIT
In a different type of news we've recently opened our official sub-reddit, you can follow Project Haven's updates and discussions there!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/ba6be38cc020d9535fa38be1410953f7bba93150.png


DEMO AND LIVE STREAM
As some of you may already know, from June 16th to June 22nd we will have an alpha demo for you guys to try out! So we have also been working on a few additions to our current build with that in mind. As always, your feedback is very important to us and if you have any comments, suggestions and even if it’s something you don’t like, we’d be very interested in hearing from you!

You will have an opportunity to talk to us in our live stream on June 19th where we will be playing the game, answer your questions and get to know you! But in case you miss it, you can join us on Discord and talk with us there at anytime.

Thanks for reading, until next time!

notes.title: Steam Game Festival Demo and Live Stream (Update)
notes.notes:
Hello Steel Dragons!

As you may be aware the Steam Game Festival has been rescheduled, due to this our Demo will now be available from June 16th until the 22nd.
The Demo will have three Campaign missions available in Single Player mode (Co-op campaign will be available in the full release) and Skirmish procedural generation maps that can be played Single Player, Co-op or PvP! Here's a quick sneak peek at the campaign levels you'll be able to play in!

[previewyoutube=fZi4cdc7eus;full][/previewyoutube]

We will still be hosting a Live Stream, which was also postponed by one week and it will be live on Friday June 19h starting at 5PM UTC (check this event info for your local time). You will be able to watch us play the Demo and chat with us!

Be sure to use the 'Set a reminder' feature to not miss the event!

Any feedback you have will be much appreciated!

See you on Friday 19th!

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes:
Hello Steel Dragons!

It's been a while since our last Steam update! If you've been following us on our Social Media or Discord server you know it's been some very busy months for us!

https://i.imgur.com/2pTBXqL.gif

Play Testing
In January we had our first alpha testing session with our Discord members which generated an immense amount of feedback and great ideas from the community. Overall we're really happy with the reception the game had. We're now hard at work making Project Haven be the best it can be. Stay tuned for news on the next testing sessions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/318d858b207b75d6cef1807c5cd4ec59df9bc093.png

Procedurally Assisted Level Design
We started the first iterations of our procedural level system:
[previewyoutube=X4AdCoFNvuA;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=OhBUsZ0LAT8;full][/previewyoutube]

Project Haven will feature levels with both procedural and hand-crafted sections. Increasing replayability but still staying in line with the heavy story component of the game.

We also streamed one of our level design sessions on Twitch. If you want to check out the next one, follow us on Twitch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35829305/a081bab5d095c47da0402a52dd7875a3bad96018.png

User Interface
Just a few days ago we've also shown our WIP mission selection screen, which also reveals how Haven city looks like from above:
[previewyoutube=uafl4OLQzo4;full][/previewyoutube]


And for those who are curious, here's an interview we did earlier in the year where you can read about what were the inspirations behind Project Haven and some of the future plans for the game.

This is it for this quick update. To stay up to date on Project Haven news make sure to follow us on our Social Media.

Until next time!
